# v0.8.8 validation record

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

This record covers the isolated `moddotplot-interactive-0.8.8-source` copy. The sibling
v0.8.7 source remains available for comparison and rollback. No deployment, upload,
tag, or remote publication is part of this local source-copy release.

## Release acceptance focus

Final integrated validation established all of the following:

* package, Rust workspace, generated Wasm package, citation, provenance, and CycloneDX
  metadata consistently identify v0.8.8;
* the landing copy identifies optional FAI/GZI companions as the faster-loading path;
* the bundled example button loads `Col-CEN_v1.2.fasta`, its matching FAI, and
  `ColCEN_CEN180.gff3`, enters the workspace, and leaves no stale or partial session
  after cancellation or failure;
* default cursor guides follow the pointer as dotted horizontal and vertical lines,
  remain non-interactive, and disappear when the pointer leaves the plot;
* Advanced options can hide the guides, select crossing diagonal geometry, and select
  dotted, dashed, or solid strokes without recomputing the plot;
* cursor guides do not appear in plot exports and do not disrupt hover, zoom, pan,
  grid, annotation, or keyboard interactions; and
* the complete unit, production-build, documentation, and supported-browser regression
  suites pass on the final integrated source.

## Verification status

The final integrated release run was completed on 2026-09-30.

| --- | --- |
| Rust formatting and linting | Passed: `cargo fmt --all --check` was clean and strict all-target/all-feature Clippy passed with warnings denied |
| Rust tests | Passed: 81 tests passed with 5 intentional benchmark/diagnostic ignores under `cargo test --workspace --all-features` |
| TypeScript unit tests | Passed: 28 Vitest files completed with 141 tests passed and 1 intentional scale-only skip |
| Production UI build | Passed: 28 modules built; optimized Wasm is 246.10 kB, 90.42 kB gzip; the production directory includes all three bundled example assets |
| Supported-browser suite | Passed: 99 Playwright cases completed across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit with 95 passed and 4 expected platform-specific skips |
| v0.8.8 feature browser matrix | Passed: 6/6 example-launch and cursor-guide cases across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit |
| Manual local preview | Passed on port 4178: the real 32.5 Mb Chr1 example and CEN180 annotation loaded; dotted horizontal/vertical guides and dashed diagonal guides were visually verified |
| Rust workspace metadata | Passed: both local crates resolve as v0.8.8 with `cargo metadata --no-deps` |
| JSON release metadata | Passed: package, lockfile, generated Wasm package, and CycloneDX documents parse and identify v0.8.8 |
| Documentation contract | Passed: 72 generated Markdown documents, local links, and current implementation contracts checked |

The manual preview used the built v0.8.8 site rather than a mocked fixture. It confirmed
that the indexed bundled FASTA reaches the 32.5 Mb Chr1 interactive self plot, the
bundled CEN180 feature data becomes available, and both default and alternate guide
presentations remain aligned with the pointer.
